join_order.notes: Bitset of 2M bits (250KB) indexed by p_partkey. Fits entirely in L2 cache. First filter applied during lineitem scan.
Dense array of s_nationkey indexed by s_suppkey (400KB). Direct O(1) lookup.
Use partsupp_pk_hash index for O(1) lookup of ps_supplycost by (l_partkey, l_suppkey).
Use orders_o_orderkey_lookup index for O(1) lookup of order row_id, then read o_orderdate.
Preloaded n_name[25] array. Chained through supplier: n_name[s_nationkey[l_suppkey]].

data_structures.part_filter_bitset: bitset(2000001) — 250KB, set bit for qualifying p_partkeys
data_structures.partsupp_hash_index: mmap partsupp_pk_hash.bin — pre-built hash table with capacity 2^24, entry 16 bytes
data_structures.orders_orderdate: mmap o_orderdate.bin — read date by row_id from orders_lookup
data_structures.ps_supplycost: mmap ps_supplycost.bin — read supplycost by row_id from partsupp hash lookup
data_structures.aggregation: direct_2d_array[25][max_years] per thread — 25 nations × ~7 years, sum_profit

indexes.purpose: join_lookup for (l_partkey, l_suppkey) → ps row_id → ps_supplycost
join_lookup for l_orderkey → orders row_id → o_orderdate

phase1_load_dimensions.description: Load nation and supplier dimension data
operations: Load n_name into string array[25] indexed by n_nationkey
Load s_nationkey into int32 array[100001] indexed by s_suppkey (1-based)

phase2_filter_parts.description: Scan p_name varlen, build bitset of qualifying partkeys

scan.output: set bit in bitset for each qualifying p_partkey

phase3_scan_lineitem.description: Parallel morsel-driven scan of lineitem with all lookups inline
per_row_logic: 1. Check part_bitset[l_partkey] → skip if not set
3. Look up partsupp_pk_hash(l_partkey, l_suppkey) → ps_row_id → ps_supplycost[ps_row_id]
4. Look up orders_lookup[l_orderkey] → o_row_id → o_orderdate[o_row_id] → extract year
5. Compute amount = l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) - ps_supplycost * l_quantity

phase4_merge_and_output.description: Merge thread-local aggregation arrays, format and sort output
phase4_merge_and_output.merge: Sum all thread-local agg arrays element-wise
phase4_merge_and_output.sort: By nation name ASC, o_year DESC

aggregation.year_extraction: days_since_epoch to year via arithmetic (e.g., modified Hinnant algorithm or lookup table)

parameters.name: p_name_pattern
parameters.usage: Extract substring between % delimiters, use strstr for contains match
